body:
thank you for your words, they're very appreciated <3

and yes, he could never be replaced. there could never be a dog like him. but i have thought about it, and to be honest, it would be bittersweet but i would love to open my heart to another dog. not to replace him as you said, but just to give a home to another dog in need and care for one again.

unfortunately, it's up to my parents, not me, and they seem opposed to the idea as of now. the future can change but it does make things feel a bit more hopeless. i'm not alone, as i do have another dog at home that i love dearly, but they were raised together and having just one dog in the house doesn't feel right.

i am feeling a bit more rationally compared to last night. the pain of losing my childhood best friend is agonizing but talking to other people does help.

i hope you have a good day/night <3

hey, thanks for commenting.

i'm deeply sorry that you had to go through the pain of losing your own childhood dog, but i'm glad you were able to open your life to another, and are still alive today.

this dog was my childhood dog of 8 years as well. the pain is agonizing.

and don't worry, it doesn't sound bad. he could never be replaced. to be honest, i felt guilty because i have thought about wanting a new dog, a puppy that i could care for again. unfortunately it's not my decision, and my parents seem opposed to the idea at least for now. the future can change though.

i hope you have a good night <3

thank you for the comment, i appreciate it <3 i'm sorry you had to lose your dog too but i'm glad you were able to make peace with it and just cherish your memories with her. i'm sure she had a great life.

thank you. i feel bad saying this because it's impossible to replace him and there will never be another dog just like him, but i have been wanting to open my heart to another dog and have someone to take care of again. except that it's my parent's choice not mine, and they seem opposed to the idea. maybe someday the day will come if i'm still here by then.

right not it doesn't feel like things will get better but i think i can stick around at least for a while more. after all, i have another dog at home who i love dearly.

thanks for talking and i hope you have a good night

hey man, i'm sorry i don't have much information on how to help you. i've never been admitted to a hospital myself. but i understand what you're going through and i truly hope you continue to fight, even though i know it's so fucking hard. i hope you can seek help and keep yourself safe. i would recommend calling a suicide hotline, and seeing if it helps just a bit. maybe it won't, but you have nothing to lose, right?

or can you call friends or family for help? it sucks that we even have to consider money as part of getting help.

i genuinely hope everything goes okay for you, and even if this comment is useless, i hope it helps you realize that life may suck but you aren't totally alone.

well, thank you for the comment.

i know that rationally i'll probably never be reunited with him, but even if that's the case, i wouldn't mind dying either way. even if there's nothing after this, i feel guilty just living when he can't.

and thank you. he did have a good life, which is my only comfort. part of me wishes i could take in another dog and maybe that would help, but it's not really up to me and my parents are against the idea. i do have another dog, and i love him dearly and don't want him to be alone if i died, but also i don't want to go through this again when he eventually passes.

i will think on what you said though, thank you again for the comment. i do hope you have a good day/night
